PluginData.Author: Viktor
PluginData.Tooltip: Shows far grids and asteroids beyond the sync distance as impostors
PluginData.Description: Shows grids and asteroids beyond the sync distance as impostors on servers running the Impostors server plugin, even when the world doesn't have the Impostors mod. In offline games and when hosting a lobby, builds them for you with the Impostors mod, loaded by the plugin if the world doesn't list it, and sends them to the players who joined.
